title: 農業分野におけるAI・データに関する契約ガイドライン～農業分野のノウハウの保護とデータ利活用促進のために～

policy_extraction.issuing_body: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (農林水産省)
covered_actors: Farmers and agricultural organizations (農業関係者)
Agricultural extension advisors (農業普及指導員)
National and local governments, national R&D agencies, and independent administrative agencies (国、地方公共団体、研究開発法人、独立行政法人)
AI R&D commissioners and commissioned R&D entities/research institutions (ＡＩ研究開発委託者・ＡＩ研究開発者)
Agricultural AI product and service providers (製品・サービス提供者)
Third parties receiving agricultural AI data, models, or intellectual property (第三者)

evidence.quote: データ受領者は、データ提供者の書面による事前の承諾のない限り、本目的以外の目的で提供データ等を加工等その他の利用をしてはならず、提供データのほか、 派生データ等、本件成果物を第三者（データ受領者が法人である場合、その子会社、関連会社も第三者に含まれる。）に開示、提供、漏えいしてはならない。

evidence.quote_en: Without the prior written consent of the data provider, the data recipient shall not process or otherwise use the provided data, etc. for any purpose other than the intended purpose, and shall not disclose, provide, or leak the provided data, derived data, etc., or the deliverables to any third party (including subsidiaries and affiliates if the data recipient is a corporation).

evidence.source_section: 第７条（本ＡＩ研究開発者の義務）
evidence.quote_en: 2. However, if the purpose of this contract such as solving the commissioning party's business issues is not achieved, the AI R&D Developer shall provide an explanation within a reasonable scope upon request.

evidence.quote:
農業関係者等の保護を適切に行う形の取決めのあり方を示すことで、農業関係者等
が安心してデータやノウハウを提供することができる環境を整備するため、本ガイド

・農業関係者等が関わる農業分野におけるＡＩを利用した製品・サービスの利用にお

・農業関係者等が提供したＡＩに関する成果の第三者提供に係る取決め
・農業分野の特殊性を踏まえたＡＩの研究開発における取決め

evidence.quote_en: To create an environment where agricultural stakeholders can provide data and know-how with peace of mind by showing contractual arrangements that appropriately protect them, this Guideline (Know-How Utilization Edition) aims to provide points to note, factors for consideration, and practical contracting tools for AI service usage, third-party provision of AI deliverables, and AI R&D reflecting the specificities of agriculture.

evidence.quote: 本ガイドライン（ノウハウ活用編）は、このようなＡＩの研究開発や利用を行う当事者における契約を円滑に行える機能も果たすことを想定する。
evidence.quote_en: This Guideline (Know-How Utilization Edition) is also intended to function to facilitate smooth contracting among parties conducting AI R&D and utilization.

evidence.quote:
国や地方公共団体がＡＩの研究開発委託者となる場合、公的資金を投入してＡＩの
研究開発を行うことから、資金投入の施策目的に応じた制限が生じうる。
evidence.quote_en: When the national or local government acts as the AI R&D commissioning party, restrictions corresponding to the policy objectives of the funding may be imposed because public funds are invested in the AI R&D.

evidence.quote:
国や地方公共団体の資金により研究開発される場合、民間事業者間での契約とは異
なり、一定の様式に基づいて契約を行うこと等が求められる。
evidence.quote_en: When R&D is conducted using funds from the national or local government, unlike contracts between private businesses, contracting based on prescribed formats and procedures is required.

policy_extraction.implementation_notes: Non-binding ministerial contract guideline ('Know-how Utilization Edition') issued by MAFF in March 2020 for the agricultural sector (smart agriculture), building on METI's AI/Data Contract Guidelines (June 2018) and MAFF's Agricultural Data Contract Guidelines (December 2018). It provides model contract clauses, checklists, and term sheet templates covering R&D data/know-how provision, commissioned AI R&D (including publicly funded projects and Japanese Bayh-Dole Act considerations), AI product/service utilization, and third-party data/model transfers. It explicitly excludes statutory AI regulations outside contractual relationships and relies on private contract law, trade secret/limited provided data protections under the Unfair Competition Prevention Act, and personal data protections under Japan's APPI.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The guideline's dominant frame is innovation_enablement because its central stated purpose is to reduce contractual uncertainty and farmers' anxieties over unintended know-how leakage so that agricultural stakeholders can safely share data and collaborate to promote AI R&D, smart agriculture adoption, and active data utilization. Economic_competitiveness is a prominent secondary frame, repeatedly invoked to justify geographic and third-party transfer restrictions on publicly funded AI models and agricultural know-how in order to strengthen Japan's international and inter-regional agricultural competitiveness. Innovation_enablement edges out economic_competitiveness because competitive restrictions are treated as context-dependent options for specific public-funding or regional cases, whereas enabling trustworthy data-sharing ecosystems and accelerating agricultural AI deployment underpins the entire document. Fundamental_rights appears as a minor secondary frame through references to personal data protection and alignment with Japan's Social Principles of Human-Centric AI, while consumer_public_safety receives only brief peripheral mention regarding existing product-safety laws and AI malfunction risks.

evidence_spans.quote: 本ガイドライン（ノウハウ活用編）では、このような農業関係者等の不安を解消し、データの利活用の活性化を図るために、データやノウハウの提供者と受領者が、納得できる合意に必要な契約上の要素や留意点について示す。
evidence_spans.source_section: 第4. 3. 【ポイント 22】サービス利用に際してのデータ提供契約とサービス利用契約約款
evidence_spans.quote_en: In order to resolve such anxieties of agricultural stakeholders and revitalize the utilization of data, this guideline (Know-how Utilization Edition) presents the contractual elements and points to note necessary for data and know-how providers and recipients to reach a mutually satisfactory agreement.

evidence_spans.quote: 本ガイドライン（ノウハウ活用編）では、データ等の提供に際して生じるノウハウ流出に関するリスクの考え方を示すことで、熟練農業者や農業普及指導員等がリスクを理解し、安心してデータ提供等を行えるようにすることも目的の一つとしている。
evidence_spans.source_section: 第1. 3. 「ＡＩ・データの利用に関する契約ガイドライン（ＡＩ編）」との関係
evidence_spans.quote_en: By presenting a way of thinking about the risks of know-how leakage that arise when providing data, etc., this guideline (Know-how Utilization Edition) also aims to enable skilled farmers, agricultural extension officers, and others to understand the risks and provide data, etc. with peace of mind.

evidence_spans.quote: 例えば国や地方公共団体が資金を投入する目的として、競争力強化を掲げてＡＩ研究開発を行うことが挙げられている場合には、提供先の範囲についても、特定地域外への提供を制限することなどを、研究開発契約の段階で明示することが必要となる。
evidence_spans.source_section: 第2. 3. 【ポイント 10】第三者提供の制限
evidence_spans.quote_en: For example, when the national or local government provides funding for AI R&D with the stated purpose of strengthening competitiveness, it is necessary to clearly specify at the R&D contract stage restrictions on the scope of recipients, such as restricting provision outside a specific region.

evidence_spans.quote: 具体的には例えば、国の事業による研究開発によるものである場合には、利用目的については、例えば競争力強化の観点から、国内の農業関係者等の生産支援等を行うための利用に限定される、など公的資金を投入した政策目的に応じた制限がなされることがある。
evidence_spans.source_section: 第4. 2. 本件成果物等の利用条件（研究開発モデル契約書案第18 条関係）
evidence_spans.quote_en: Specifically, for example, in the case of R&D under a national government project, restrictions in accordance with the policy objectives of public funding may be imposed, such as limiting the purpose of use to supporting production by domestic agricultural stakeholders from the perspective of strengthening competitiveness.

evidence_spans.quote: 3 つの理念を実現する社会を構築することを目指し、ＡＩと人間のかかわり方について各種原則を示した。ＡＩの利用は、基本的人権を侵すものであってはならないとする人間中心の原則を掲げた。
evidence_spans.source_section: 第5. 1. 表 17 人間中心のＡＩ社会原則の概要
evidence_spans.quote_en: Aiming to build a society that realizes three core philosophies, it set out various principles regarding the relationship between AI and humans. It put forward a human-centric principle that the use of AI must not infringe upon fundamental human rights.
